criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: S6 strongest; S8 real caliche relief with 7 rivets matching partner_years; S1 and S9 bookend. S4 plain blocks with frosted ghosts on a flat field, plate, parallels and vise from the CRAFT PLAN missing. S3 gold squiggle wire over the cubes reads as a worm and blurs the rows. S7 hangar out-of-focus panels, tag reads as a luggage tag. S1 and S5 on a gradient sweep with little contact.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds; gold keeps one meaning; engine motif evolves S1, S6, S9. S8 caliche and red breaks the material vocabulary.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. S4 headline 'Data files up to 73 percent smaller' and its shrunk bar infer file size past the source's 'reduced data files up to 73%', which most plausibly means file count given the 30 percent volume figure; dek and caption faithful. S1 'AI maintenance tools' covers the PSV which c2 does not call AI. S9 headline universal names its set only in the dek. Single release; first comment calls a news post and a homepage 'two official records'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, funder, where and what named; every result labelled in testing. Stake general; watch line not actionable.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns a look; S3 to S5 similar beats; S6 the one real turn; S8 late; S9 lands.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; caption hook and payoff good; reads close to a press-release restatement; S7 dek generic.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject; house v2 blue, familiar relief and grid moves.

one_sentence_fix: Rewrite the S4 headline and art to what the source says, data files cut by up to 73 percent, and build the plate, parallels and vise.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Plain blocks on a flat field; plan's plate, parallels and vise missing; smaller framing overstates the source.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bars on parallels on a granite plate in a shop; files as a count of fewer blanks.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Gold squiggle wire over the cubes reads as a worm and adds a second accent meaning.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the squiggle; light the last gold cube as the focal point.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Out-of-focus panels, flat mat, luggage-tag tag.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Hard warm door light across the bench, engine soft behind, wired safety tag on the root.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bare gradient sweep with thin contact, product shot in a void.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Contact-hardening shadows and worn floor under feet and cases, lower camera.
